dos.text: Set the accessKey property rather than the accesskey attribute when the key should also register on the control, only the property setter forwards it via control.setAttribute("accesskey", val).
Use shownaccesskey instead of accesskey when the control already registers its own, it underlines the character for display without adding a second real accesskey to the element.

donts.text: Don't point control at an element inside the same shadow root, labeledControlElement resolves it with document.getElementById, so it comes back null and the click handler silently does nothing.

Don't expect clicking the label to toggle an HTML checkbox referenced by control, _onClick only focuses it and special-cases XUL checkbox/radio localNames, so use the native for attribute if you want real label activation.
Don't rely on the accesskey underline being visible everywhere, formatAccessKey returns early unless the platform underline check passes, which is off on macOS.
Don't read textContent after setting enable-center-crop, the getter is overridden to return the value attribute instead of the element's real text.
